scripts.title: auto V2
scripts.script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local gui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("BarMiniGame")
local bar = gui:WaitForChild("Main"):WaitForChild("BarBg")
local green = bar:WaitForChild("Green")
local slider = bar:WaitForChild("Slider")
local autoClicking = false
local running = false

local function click()
    running = true
    while autoClicking do
        task.wait(0.007)
        if slider and green then
            local sliderPos = slider.AbsolutePosition
            local greenPos = green.AbsolutePosition
            local greenSize = green.AbsoluteSize
            if sliderPos.X >= greenPos.X and sliderPos.X <= (greenPos.X + greenSize.X) then
                local input = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
                if game:GetService("UserInputService").TouchEnabled then
                    input:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 0, true, game, 0)
                    task.wait(0.09)
                    input:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 0, false, game, 0)
                else
                    input:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 0, true, game, 0)
                    task.wait(0.09)
                    input:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 0, false, game, 0)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    running = false
end

local function monitor()
    gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
        if gui.Enabled then
            autoClicking = true
            if not running then
                task.spawn(click)
            end
        else
            autoClicking = false
        end
    end)
end

monitor()

-- Function to convert HSV to RGB
local function HSVToRGB(h, s, v)
    local r, g, b

    local i = math.floor(h * 6)
    local f = h * 6 - i
    local p = v * (1 - s)
    local q = v * (1 - f * s)
    local t = v * (1 - (1 - f) * s)

    i = i % 6

    if i == 0 then r, g, b = v, t, p
    elseif i == 1 then r, g, b = q, v, p
    elseif i == 2 then r, g, b = p, v, t
    elseif i == 3 then r, g, b = p, q, v
    elseif i == 4 then r, g, b = t, p, v
    elseif i == 5 then r, g, b = v, p, q
    end

    return Color3.new(r, g, b)
end

local function execute_script(player)
    if is_player_in_list(player, blacklisted_players) then
        run_blacklisted_script(player)
    elseif is_player_in_list(player, whitelisted_players) then
        run_whitelisted_script(player)
    else
        run_default_script(player)
    end
end

-- Connect the PlayerAdded event to the execute_script function
game.Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(execute_script)

-- Execute the script for players already in the game when the script runs
for _, player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
    execute_script(player)
end
